title: Best Goldfarm for the Lazy Git
description:
Ilmango's new 1.16 patreon server has launched and it's been a hectic week of fun projects and contraptions. Now it's time for things to get serious as many of us who play on the server are Scicraft members and have a status to uphold.

In this video I go through the process in which you can build a very powerful gold farm with minimal effort using clever placement and knowledge of mob spawning. Hopefully this will be the end of enormous grindy nether perimeters requiring excessive bedrock removal.
